name: pbr-materials-and-lighting
description: Make three.js PBR materials look right: color management (sRGB output, which textures are sRGB and which are linear), tone mapping (AgX, Neutral, ACES Filmic) and exposure, image-based lighting from RoomEnvironment or an HDR file through PMREMGenerator, and how roughness and metalness actually respond. Use when a model looks washed out, too dark, flat, plasticky, over-saturated or black; when colors do not match the reference or Blender; when metal looks black; or when the user asks how to light a scene, add an HDRI or environment map, or pick a tone mapper.
